Claim 1. (Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor, __wherein the escalated alarm is distinct from the first alarm and comprises an increased level of urgency compared to the first alarm__.

Claim 16. (Currently Amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, __and an escalation status indicating whether the alarm has been escalated__; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data, __wherein the system is configured to track and display changes in alarm escalation status over time__.

Claim 17. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, __wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system and is configured to manage escalation of alarms across both the physiological monitor and the central management system__.

Claim 18. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises __detailed__ information about a level of escalation of the alarm, __including a timestamp of each escalation event__.

Claim 19. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm, __including which device or operator acknowledged the alarm and the time of acknowledgement__.

Claim 20. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data __including escalation status and acknowledgement information__ to one or more wireless devices __only when the alarm has not been acknowledged within a predetermined time threshold__.
